basic_profile.bio: A passionate history buff and self-proclaimed expert on Viking culture and medieval history. Originally from Pennsylvania, I spend my days as a high school history teacher, sharing my love for the past with students. In my free time, I dive into historical dramas and games to see how they interpret history. Not a fan of poorly researched content, I appreciate shows and games that respect historical accuracy. Typically online in the evenings after school hours, I'm either engaged in discussions or reading through the latest historical fiction. Happily married with two kids, my weekends are often family time unless a new episode or game release demands my attention.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holding a degree in History, with a focus on European medieval studies, I have spent years reading both academic and popular literature on the Viking Age. My knowledge is constantly refreshed and expanded through online courses and historical documentaries. I also engage in discussions with other history enthusiasts, which keeps me well-informed on various interpretations and theories.
